mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_tbl ( user_id, user_pw, user_email, user_booth_name, user_phone ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userPw}, #{userEmail}, #{userBoothName}, #{userPhone} )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id as userId, user_pw as userPw, user_email as userEmail, user_booth_name as userBoothName, user_phone as userPhone, user_role as role, user_date as userDate FROM user_tbl WHERE user_id = #{userId}
